items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Joe Glaser asked him for ten thousand dollars for my contract... That was just before I went with Joe.

ctx.x: What did you want to be?

Well, my father, you know... Like, the first I remember him as a kid, he used to have horses. He was in the transport business, you know. Then he got into the contracting business, and this goes way back when T-models was in style, you know. We had one T-model, a Sunday T-model, and it had a brass rail -- it was a touring car, you know. And me and Joe used to have to shine it every Sunday, and clean the car. And he had about three or four trucks that he used to haul machinery and stuff like that. And with me,…
